about.title: Beyond the expected.
about.p1: NØFORM is an independent streetwear concept imagined in Berlin in 2026. Born from the meeting of urban movement and sculptural design, it explores clothing as a space for self-expression.
about.p2: The first collection brings together oversized hoodies, washed cargo denim and a signature mirrored visor. A monochrome palette connects every piece; a trace of pink interrupts the familiar.
about.p3: NØFORM takes its name from the refusal to accept a fixed form. Silhouettes remain open, proportions shift, and the wearer gives each look its own meaning.
about.disclaimer: FICTIONAL BRAND / A CONCEPT BY VOLODINA WEB STUDIO

code.title: DESIGN CODE
code.p1: Volume creates room for movement. Dropped shoulders and generous proportions leave the silhouette open.
code.p2: One continuous curve connects the visor to the letterforms. Monochrome reveals texture; a trace of pink marks the detail.
